description:
The Sonics are stronger in numbers in their bleak purgatory zone, but no better at keeping the Sonics in the real world out of trouble. As morale sinks and confusion grows, a crack team of Sonics decide to venture out into the desolate nothingness to bring a runaway Sonic home, while the rejects are left to keep their real-world counterpart out of trouble. What they're not expecting, though, is a phenomenon they've never seen before that, with any luck, could be their ticket out of this fate worse than death...
